name: Online Education Platforms
summary: Thesis focuses on scalable online learning platforms capitalizing on workforce reskilling demand and corporate training budgets. Key bets include platform monetization of free users, content library expansion moats, and international growth against challenges of customer acquisition costs and credential commoditization. Pure-play edtech anchors offer higher exposure than diversified education peers.

relationships.note: Both compete in enterprise/government MOOC certification market
Overlap in student user base for supplemental learning
